title: Test materialization capacity rechecks after admission
outcome: Test materialization capacity rechecks after admission
acceptance: Deterministic tests exercise the existing-shared and freshly-owned publication branches after unrelated sibling growth between initial admission and their capacity recheck, asserting the appropriate bound refusal and preservation of state from the injected boundary onward.
The tests fail when either publication recheck ignores its forwarded shared capacity, retain positive permitted-capacity controls, and leave the production 100000-entry limit unchanged.

completion.summary: Added deterministic regression tests for both publication capacity rechecks after sibling growth, with exact refusals, preserved boundary state, and permitted-capacity/repeat controls. Both temporary weakened-bound mutants failed as intended; production capacity remains 100000.
